name: soft-delete
title: Soft-delete invoices
body:
## Motivation

Support keeps asking engineering to remove invoices from the dashboard: test invoices people create on production, and drafts raised against the wrong customer (SUP-212). Today the only way is a manual `DELETE` in the database, which loses the row for good and breaks the audit trail finance relies on. This adds a soft delete: the invoice disappears from the API but stays in the table, and can be brought back if someone deletes the wrong one.

## Changes

- Migration adds a nullable `deleted_at` column to `invoices` (`DEFAULT NULL`, so existing rows stay live and nothing needs backfilling).
- `DELETE /invoices/:id` marks the invoice as deleted and returns it. Only draft and void invoices can be deleted; an issued invoice is still a live receivable and has to be voided first.
- `POST /invoices/:id/restore` clears `deleted_at` and returns the invoice.
- Deleted invoices are hidden: `GET /invoices` filters them out in the query, and `GET /invoices/:id` returns 404 for them.
- `GET /invoices?includeDeleted=true` shows them again for admins; the readonly key gets a 403 for that flag. The auth hook now records the key's role on the request so routes can check it.
- The invoice response gains `isDeleted` and `deletedAt`, so the dashboard can grey out a deleted invoice in the admin view.
- The readonly key may now call `DELETE` as well: the support tool runs with that key and is what will do the clean-up.

## Testing

- Two new `app.inject` tests with the frozen clock: deleting a draft returns 200 with `isDeleted: true`, and the list hides the deleted invoice unless `includeDeleted=true` is passed.
- Ran `pnpm dev`, deleted and restored a couple of invoices with curl and checked they dropped out of and came back into the list.
- `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint` and `pnpm test` are green.

## Open questions

- I let readonly keys delete because support asked, is that ok?
